_meta.description: Key workflow definitions for the ecommerce platform knowledge graph.

guest_cart_lifecycle.title: Guest Cart Lifecycle
steps: GET /api/cart: No user session, no guest_cart_session cookie
CartService.getOrCreateCart() creates new cart with session_id (UUID4 × 2)
Response sets guest_cart_session httpOnly cookie (30-day TTL)
Guest adds items: ownership verified by session cookie match
User logs in
POST /api/cart/merge: guest cart items merged into authenticated cart
Guest cart status → merged; carts.merged_from = guest_cart_id
guest_cart_session cookie cleared
guest_cart_lifecycle.security: httpOnly cookie prevents XSS reading; 256-bit entropy prevents brute-force; assertCartOwnership() prevents cross-session theft

order_placement.title: Order Placement Flow
steps: POST /api/orders/create with cartItems, addresses, paymentProvider (stripe | cod), couponCode
buildCheckoutSummary(): validates cart items (re-fetches prices from DB)
buildCheckoutSummary(): validates coupon (soft check — usage, dates, minimum)
buildCheckoutSummary(): getTaxConfig(countryCode) → region-specific rates
buildCheckoutSummary(): calculatePricing() — pure function, server-side
If paymentProvider = 'stripe': create Stripe PaymentIntent → return clientSecret
Client collects payment via Stripe.js
Stripe webhook: POST /api/webhooks/stripe (payment_intent.succeeded)
Webhook verifies Stripe signature
Idempotency key checked (prevent duplicate processing)
create_order_atomic() RPC executes in single transaction
Order created; cart status → converted
Response: order_id, order_number returned to client

error_paths.P0001: Insufficient stock → 409, show stock errors to customer
error_paths.P0003: Coupon limit exceeded → 409, remove coupon, show message
error_paths.P0004: Coupon already used → 409, remove coupon, show message

order_placement.disabled: razorpay — webhook handler not implemented; excluded from orderRequestSchema and checkoutExtrasSchema

cart_merge.title: Guest-to-Authenticated Cart Merge
cart_merge.trigger: Guest user logs in with active guest cart
steps: POST /api/cart/merge with guestCartId
Verify guest cart ownership (session cookie match)
Verify authenticated cart ownership (user JWT)
If authenticated cart has items: merge (guest items added to auth cart, quantity caps applied)
If authenticated cart is empty: guest cart reassigned to user_id
Guest cart status → merged
Updated CartSummary returned
guest_cart_session cookie cleared

add_to_cart.title: Add to Cart — Merge / Additive Behavior
add_to_cart._adr: Defined in this workflow doc (no standalone ADR needed — behavior is straightforward).

invariants.line_uniqueness: cart_id + product_variant_id. Same SKU/variant ALWAYS merges into one line; different color/size variants are always separate lines.
invariants.quantity_rule: final_quantity = existing_quantity + requested_quantity, capped by min(available_stock, CART_MAX_QUANTITY=50).
invariants.update_rule: Cart drawer +/- controls call PATCH (updateCartItemQuantity) — REPLACE semantics. Drawer controls do not call addCartItem.
invariants.stock_validation: PDP quantity max = available_stock − already_in_cart (additive-aware). Server enforces same rule before upsert.
invariants.server_authority: Server always returns the authoritative CartSummary after each mutation. Client never computes final quantity independently.

server_flow: fetchVariant(): verify is_active + get inventory_levels (source of truth)
existing = SELECT quantity FROM cart_items WHERE cart_id + variant_id
UPSERT cart_items ON CONFLICT(cart_id, variant_id) DO UPDATE
Return CartSummary + add_result { previous_quantity, added_quantity, final_quantity, was_capped, was_new_item }
client_flow: useAddCartItem().mutate() → optimistic addItem() on Zustand legacy items
CartDrawer renders from serverCart.items (CartItemDetail) — single source of truth
Toast: smart feedback from add_result (new item / additive merge / capped)

toast_messages.was_capped: 'Qty capped at {final} (stock limit). {variantLabel} updated in cart.'

return_flow.title: Return & Refund Flow
return_flow.trigger: Customer requests return on delivered order
steps: checkReturnEligibility(orderId, userId): verify ownership, status=delivered, within 30-day window
Return request created (status: requested)
Admin reviews: approve or reject
If approved: pickup_scheduled → in_transit → received
Admin inspects item: accepted | rejected_after_inspection
If accepted: calculateRefund() → proportional items + tax + shipping (if full return)
Refund issued via payment provider (StripeProvider.refund())
inventory_levels.quantity += returned_qty (restock, explicit audit movement)
order_items.returned_quantity updated
Order status updated: refunded | partially_returned | partially_refunded
edge_cases: Partial return: only some items returned
Replacement instead of refund: replacement_shipped flow
Rejection after inspection: no refund, item returned to customer

cms_content_publish.title: CMS Content Publishing
steps: Editor edits localized_cms_pages for (country, language)
Content saved as draft in cms_page_versions
Editor clicks Publish
requireAdminPermission('cms:publish_locale') or 'cms:publish_country'
cms_page_versions.status → published
localized_cms_pages.published_version updated
Content immediately live for that locale
inheritance_break: Editor can now write locale-specific content

address_validation.title: Address Validation at Checkout
address_validation.trigger: Customer selects a saved address on the checkout page
steps: Address panel onSelect fires handleShippingSelect / handleBillingSelect (auto — no manual 'Verify' button)
validateSavedAddress(address) called immediately on selection
POST /api/address/validate: server-side authoritative check
checkout-address-validator.ts reads x-country header
LocationService.getLocationAddressRules(countryIso): fetches address rules from DB
Validates: required fields, postal code format (regex), state validity (DB lookup), city validity
Returns: { valid: boolean, errors: Record<string, string>, normalized: address }
If invalid: show field errors to customer; Place Order button stays blocked
If valid: shippingValidated / billingValidated set true; Place Order button unblocked
address_validation.performance_note: Addresses prefetched into TanStack Query cache by CartHydrationProvider when cart.item_count > 0 and user is authenticated (staleTime: 60s).

inventory_reservation.title: Inventory Reservation During Order Creation
steps: All variant_ids extracted from order items
SELECT FOR UPDATE on inventory_levels WHERE variant_id IN (...) ORDER BY variant_id
Sorted acquisition prevents deadlock (all transactions acquire in same order)
Check available = quantity - reserved >= requested for each variant
If any insufficient: RAISE EXCEPTION 'P0001' → rollback
UPDATE inventory_levels SET reserved = reserved + qty for each variant
Order creation proceeds
On order cancellation: reserved -= qty
On order delivery: quantity -= qty (actual stock deduction)

admin_stock_adjustment.title: Admin Stock Adjustment (Audited)
admin_stock_adjustment.trigger: Admin clicks 'Adjust' on any inventory cell or SKU row
admin_stock_adjustment.chosen_behavior: Two-step atomic write: (1) UPSERT inventory_levels, (2) INSERT inventory_movements
invariants: Every admin stock change creates an inventory_movements record (source_type='admin')
adjustment_reason is always set for admin adjustments
previous_quantity and new_quantity are always captured in the movement record
Stock cannot go below 0 (computeNewQuantity enforces Math.max(0, ...))
flow: User clicks Adjust button on MatrixView cell or SkuTable row
AdjustmentModal opens with prefilled current quantity and variant details
User selects operation (increase/decrease/set), enters amount, picks reason, optional note
Preview line shows: stock will change from X → Y
Service: SELECT current qty from inventory_levels (default warehouse)
Service: UPSERT inventory_levels SET quantity = newQty
Service: INSERT inventory_movements with adjustment_reason, source_type='admin', created_by
Modal closes, useStockAdjustment invalidates adminProducts.all + inventory_movements cache

product_list.description: Enhanced list with hierarchy, inventory, price range, market chips, status badge, relative updated-at. Client-side filtering on 50-product pages.

product_edit.description: Tabbed edit page: Overview | Media | Variants | Inventory | Pricing | SEO | Publishing | Shipping

tabs.media: Drag-reorder images, primary toggle, alt-text, variant image assignment
tabs.variants: Color × Size matrix + variant modal (SKU, price, barcode, active, default)
tabs.inventory: Read-only stock summary per variant, link to /admin/inventory
tabs.pricing: Base price, compare price, product code
tabs.seo: SEO title + meta description with char counters and live search preview
tabs.publishing: Active/Featured toggles, region-grouped searchable country selector
tabs.shipping: Weight, L×W×H (migration 00027), fulfillment type, tax class, returnable toggle

product_duplication.description: Clone product as Draft with new slug, clear product_code, clone images (reuse URLs), clone variants (append -COPY to SKUs), create inventory rows at 0.
invariants: product_code is set to null on duplication — must be assigned manually
Variant SKUs get '-COPY' suffix to avoid unique constraint violations
Barcodes are cleared to avoid GTIN duplication

variant_matrix.description: Color × Size grid where each cell represents one variant. Clicking an existing cell opens the VariantModal for editing. Clicking an empty cell opens VariantModal pre-filled with that color+size.
variant_matrix.generate_missing_skus: Scans variants without a sku and generates one from color code + size code. Uses updateVariant() for each.

locale_detection.title: Locale Detection & Routing
steps: middleware.ts intercepts request
If /admin/* or /api/*: skip locale processing
If URL has /{country}/{lang}/: validate country and lang codes
If valid: use URL params as locale
If invalid country/lang: redirect to default
If URL is /: check cookies (x-locale-pref, x-country-pref, x-lang-pref)
If no cookies: check geo headers (cf-ipcountry, x-vercel-ip-country)
If no geo: parse Accept-Language header
If no match: default to /in/en/
Set request headers: x-country, x-language, x-locale-id, x-text-direction
Set/update locale cookies (1-year expiry)
